newsitem.title: USA: Banc One sells $900 mln in two-part deal.
newsitem.headline: Banc One sells $900 mln in two-part deal.

text.p: The following two-tranche issue from Banc One Corp was priced on Thursday, according to market sources.
The offering of $500 million in 30-year subordinated debentures was underwritten by Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
The offering of $400 million in 10-year subordinated notes was underwritten by Salomon Brothers Inc.
